items.title: Russia Prepares to Reroute Grain Exports From Sea of Azov After Ukrainian Attacks
items.description: Shipping in the Sea of Azov remained restricted on Tuesday, according to Reuters sources, marking the biggest disruption to the Black Sea grain trade since the start of the war in Ukraine.

items.description: The final July 14 parade presided over by President Emmanuel Macron, the event brought together thousands of French troops but also two dozen foreign heads of state and government, including Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky.

items.title: France's Bastille Day parade showcases European support for Ukraine
items.description: France's annual July 14 military parade this year featured aircraft from 11 European countries and around 500 troops from Coalition of the Willing allies that have pledged to help with Ukraine’s post-war security in a showcase of support for Kyiv. Winter was harsh, but resilient Odesa making summer a season of hope
items.description: Odesa, home to a Ukrainian seaport that is a critical link in the global food security chain, endured its worst winter of Russian attacks since the war began, then prepared for a vibrant summer with a determination not just to survive but to build a better future.

items.title: The U.S. strikes Iran after Trump announces a renewed blockade and tolls in Hormuz
items.description: The U.S. and Iran are fighting for control of the Strait of Hormuz, threatening a return to all-out war after agreeing to a ceasefire last month.

items.title: Zelenskyy Fights Another Political Battle With Another Cabinet Shake-Up In Ukraine
items.description: Zelenskyy gave no explanation for the unexpected shuffle of his Cabinet. But the popularity of Ukraine’s one-and-only wartime president is slipping, as war-weary voters tire of political scandals, as well as the unrelenting Russian invasion.

items.title: Iran: Living in limbo between war and ceasefire
items.description: Repeated ceasefire violations, contradictory political signals and ongoing emergency measures have fueled exhaustion, anger and deep uncertainty among many Iranians.

items.title: Sudan's paramilitary RSF chief sentenced to death over war crimes
items.description: Mohamed Hamdan Dagalo was convicted in absentia along with 15 RSF commanders and allies.

items.title: Strait of Hormuz: UN agencies call for diplomacy to end attacks
items.description: As both Washington and Tehran claim to control the critical commercial shipping route through the narrow Strait of Hormuz, UN agencies on Monday are calling for de-escalation amid the recent spike in strikes in the region related to the US-Iran war.
